usedFor: AgencyAccess onboards clients with one link, and “New Client” or “New Access Request” can start follow-up work for your team.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Access Request” in AgencyAccess
bestTemplate.why: A new booking is a client who needs account access, and the action sends the access request.

watchOut: “Create Access Request” reaches a client outside your team, so it waits for your approval before it goes.
